page_title: MCI 1-0 BRE | Manchester City v Brentford 20/02/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' That's it for today, Darren England has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+6' Mark Flekken (Brentford) will have to be careful for the rest of the match as he is shown a yellow card.
90+6' The corner kick from Mathias Jensen (Brentford) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.
90+5' Good defending. Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) tries to find Erling Haaland inside the box, but the pass is cut out.

90+3' Erling Haaland (Manchester City) receives a clever pass and shoots from mid-range. His shot looks like it's going in the middle of the goal, but Mark Flekken has other ideas and makes a brilliant save.
90+2' Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) works the corner short.
90+1' Phil Foden (Manchester City) amazingly found his way through the defence, but lacked a precise finish as his effort from close range went slightly wide of the left post.
90' The fourth official shows 6 min. of added time.
89' Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
89' The referee signals a substitution. Mateo Kovacic (Manchester City) is brought on as a substitute for Julian Alvarez.
89' Here is a change. Mads Roerslev Rasmussen is going off and Thomas Frank gives the last tactical orders to Saman Ghoddos (Brentford).
89' The substitution has been made. Mikkel Damsgaard (Brentford) has replaced Frank Onyeka.

89' Mark Flekken makes a good save! Phil Foden (Manchester City) easily weaves through the defence and fires in from long range. His shot goes towards the roof of the net but is saved by the keeper! The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Manchester City.
85' Manchester City control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
82' What was Kyle Walker (Manchester City) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
80' GOAL DISALLOWED! Controversy and anger as Erling Haaland (Manchester City) has a goal ruled out, incredibly, for offside.
78' A substitution has been made. Sergio Reguilon (Brentford) goes off and Keane Lewis-Potter comes on.
77' It is time for a substitution. Mathias Jensen (Brentford) is on for Vitaly Janelt.

72' What a poor attempt! Ivan Toney (Brentford) drives another shot towards goal - this time from further out, but it couldn't have been worse if he had shot blindfolded. The ball goes into the stands.

71' 1 - 0 Julian Alvarez slides a pass towards Erling Haaland (Manchester City) who unleashes a fabulous shot from long range. The ball goes behind the surprised goalkeeper and into the bottom left corner. The score is now 1:0.

69' Phil Foden (Manchester City) clutches his head after wasting a good opportunity. He expertly collected the ball from a rebound and fired from long range, but his effort wasn't accurate at all and the ball went miles over the crossbar.
69' The goalkeeper punched the ball away after Julian Alvarez (Manchester City) took the corner.
69' Julian Alvarez (Manchester City) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. Manchester City have been awarded a corner kick.
68' Thomas Frank decides to make a substitution. Yoane Wissa will be replaced by Neal Maupay (Brentford).
68' Ivan Toney (Brentford) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
66' Ben Mee (Brentford) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
66' Ben Mee (Brentford) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
66' Bernardo Silva (Manchester City) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Erling Haaland, but he can't get on the end of the pass.
63' The foul by Julian Alvarez (Manchester City) was seen by Darren England who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
61' The substitution is prepared. Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Oscar Bobb.
60' Yellow card. Yoane Wissa (Brentford) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.

58' Rodri (Manchester City) reacts well and displays good awareness near the penalty spot to get on the end of a cross from the free kick. He jumps high and produces a header which goes well wide of the right post.
54' Ruben Dias (Manchester City) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows for a foul after seeing the whole situation.
52' The ball rebounds to Rodri (Manchester City) and he shoots from distance, but the keeper calmly watches it drift well wide of the right post.
49' Julian Alvarez (Manchester City) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

49' Bernardo Silva (Manchester City) creates himself some space and attempts to put the ball into the box. However, the defender gets an important foot in to clear. Manchester City will take a corner kick.
47' A pass from Phil Foden (Manchester City) is intercepted by Mark Flekken and the move breaks down.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+3' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+2' The game is interrupted. Ben Mee (Brentford) is given a yellow card. He has to be more careful now.
45+2' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by John Stones (Manchester City) was quite harsh and Darren England didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.

44' Ruben Dias (Manchester City) receives a low pass just outside the box and unleashes a fine strike towards the left post. Mark Flekken pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill, indeed.
43' Frank Onyeka (Brentford) rises above the defenders and places a towering header towards the left post, but Ederson is prepared and dives to thwart him.
42' Sergio Reguilon (Brentford) takes the free kick which is inaccurate and the defence has no problem with the clearance.
42' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Phil Foden (Manchester City). Darren England saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul. Brentford have a free kick.
41' Total attempts – 15:4.
39' The corner by Julian Alvarez (Manchester City) lacks accuracy as it's hit with too much power.
39' Manuel Akanji (Manchester City) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender. Now Manchester City have a corner.

38' Oscar Bobb (Manchester City) takes a good touch to control a cross on the edge of the box and fires a low drive towards the middle of the goal, but one of the defenders reacts brilliantly to block his effort.
36' A corner kick by Manchester City is thwarted by the well prepared Mark Flekken (Brentford).

36' Mark Flekken makes a superb save to deny a header which was nodded towards the bottom left corner by Ruben Dias (Manchester City). The ball is out of play and Manchester City manage to earn a corner.
36' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Manchester City.
36' Manuel Akanji (Manchester City) fires a bullet of a shot from distance, but the goalkeeper blocks his attempt. Manchester City get a corner.
34' Kyle Walker crosses and Bernardo Silva (Manchester City) misses a great opportunity with his head from close in, sending the ball just wide of the right post.
33' Zanka (Brentford) sends a long ball in, but Ederson comfortably gathers the ball.
30' Oscar Bobb is the provider with a good cross and Erling Haaland (Manchester City) shows great determination to get to the ball on the edge of the box, but he blazes it high over the bar.
28' Julian Alvarez (Manchester City) picks up a pass and fires a powerful long-range shot which goes painfully close to the left post.
26' Julian Alvarez (Manchester City) picks up the rebound from his own attempted pass and decides to shoot from mid-range. He shouldn't have bothered as the ball flies miles over the bar.
25' Bernardo Silva (Manchester City) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.
22' Yoane Wissa (Brentford) is forced to stop his attacking move after the linesman signals for offside.
21' Mark Flekken comes off his line to intercept the corner from Bernardo Silva (Manchester City).
19' Ivan Toney (Brentford) receives the ball from the set piece and unleashes a strike from the edge of the box, but his effort goes narrowly wide of the left post!

19' Ruben Dias (Manchester City) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Darren England blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion. Brentford have been awarded a free kick.
17' Julian Alvarez (Manchester City) evades the challenge and decides to shoot from distance, but it was a poor decision as the ball balloons high over the bar.
16' Frank Onyeka (Brentford) picks up a pass and tries his luck from mid-range low towards the middle of the goal, but Ederson is equal to it and makes an easy save.
15' The ball possession at the moment is 62:38.
11' A thunderous effort from long range by Sergio Reguilon (Brentford) goes well wide of the left post.
11' Ivan Toney (Brentford) tries to find Yoane Wissa, but he puts too much power on the through ball.
9' Bernardo Silva plays a lofted ball into Erling Haaland (Manchester City) near the penalty spot, but the ball flies off the top of his head and goes high over the bar.
8' Phil Foden (Manchester City) had a good opportunity from long range. His shot was directed towards the bottom right corner, but Mark Flekken was alert and made a comfortable save.
7' Phil Foden (Manchester City) strikes a volley towards goal from long-range, but one of the defenders blocks his effort.
7' Julian Alvarez (Manchester City) attempts to find a teammate with the corner, but the effort is snuffed out by the goalkeeper.
6' Julian Alvarez (Manchester City) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Manchester City.
4' Kyle Walker (Manchester City) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.

3' Mark Flekken makes a good save! Erling Haaland (Manchester City) easily weaves through the defence and fires in from long range. His shot goes towards the middle of the goal but is saved by the keeper!
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Brentford will kick-off.
Darren England will officiate today.
